title: Levels Late Meal Variability
app: Apple Health / Apple Watch exports, Oura, WHOOP, Dexcom, Levels, LibreView, Eight Sleep, Withings, and Garmin Body Battery feeds via vendor APIs, exports, Home Assistant bridges, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=levels:glucose
| eval hour=tonumber(strftime(_time,"%H"))
| where hour>=20
| bin _time span=1d
| stats max(glucose_mgdl) as late_peak, min(glucose_mgdl) as late_low by person _time
| eval spread=late_peak-late_low
| where spread>50
| sort - spread
description: Uses Levels glucose traces telemetry to monitor how volatile glucose became after late meals in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for evening habits that create large swings, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Levels glucose traces data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Daily table of late-meal peak, low, and spread.
grandmaExplanation: It reveals how volatile glucose became after late meals so you can spot evening habits that create large swings before it becomes annoying.
